title: Fullscreen media carousel (Springs)
source: springs.estate /gallery + full-viewport residence/interior media slides ("SEARCH FLATS" beats). Engine = library/components/fullscreen-media-carousel (proven, imperative go/next/prev + built-in arrows/keys/pointer-drag/IntersectionObserver video pause). NO engine patch needed.
engine: An edge-to-edge full-bleed carousel: each .fmc-slide fills the WHOLE viewport (no card chrome), the .fmc-track translateX(-index*100%), stepping one full width at a time. Imperative: go(i)/next()/prev()/index(), count; wires ‹ ›, Left/Right keys, pointer drag/swipe (F-08); a video slide plays only while active AND on-screen (IntersectionObserver).
differs: Same push-slide mechanic (track translateX(-index*100%)) + same go/next/prev. INTERACTION differs (not the driver source but the INPUT surface): desktop uses the round ‹ › buttons (click / Left-Right keys); mobile uses touch-swipe on the full-bleed frame. NO ambient auto-advance on either platform — a carousel is a swipe/arrow affordance, it must not self-page (S20). Springs mobile is a swipeable full-bleed slider; desktop is arrow-paged.

desktop.driver: arrowNav — the engine already wired .fmc-prev/.fmc-next + Left/Right keys; nothing extra.

mobile.driver: swipe — the engine already wires pointer drag/swipe (F-08); clean swipe, NO auto-advance timer.

loop.what: wrap past the ends; when false, arrows disable at the ends.

drag.what: pointer drag/swipe on the stage (release past max(60px,12%) steps).

engine_patch: NONE — imperative, interaction-driven engine (go/next/prev). No scroll driver, no narrow-guard that kills motion on phone width, so NO forceMotion patch (go() works identically on any width). The wrapper only chooses the INPUT surface: desktop arrows/keys (engine-native), mobile swipe (engine-native pointer drag).
entry: FullscreenMediaCarouselDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .fmc-stage > .fmc-track > .fmc-slide (img|video) xN + .fmc-prev/.fmc-next + optional .fmc-counter(.fmc-cur/.fmc-total).
law: transform: translateX (track) only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend over the media; NO backdrop over the moving slide; NO WebGL. Videos muted+loop+playsinline, play only when active+on-screen (IntersectionObserver), never scrub currentTime. reduced-motion → instant index (show first slide static, no push).
